title: Maintenance in Jacó: Preventive & Corrective | MA Soluciones
description: Property maintenance in Jacó: roofs, humidity, painting and repairs. Contracts for condos and vacation rentals. 48 h response.
lead: General maintenance in Jacó for homes, condos and vacation rentals: roofs, leaks, painting, electrical and repairs. One team for yearly preventive tasks and for urgent fixes during the rainy season.
heroAlt: Residential property maintenance in Jacó, Costa Rica

highlights.title: Preventive contracts
highlights.text: Monthly or quarterly inspection and minor-repair plans that stop a small leak from becoming a major repair.

highlights.title: Rainy-season ready
highlights.text: Before May we inspect roofs, gutters and seals; after the season we prioritize wind and water damage repairs.

highlights.title: 48-hour response
highlights.text: Being local, we schedule visits in Jacó within 48 hours for humidity, electrical or plumbing emergencies.

zoneLinkText: Jacó is the tourist and residential hub of the Central Pacific, between Garabito, Herradura and Playa Hermosa. We serve the area from our local base.

faqs.a: Yes. We work with owners, condo managers and vacation rental operators with personalized preventive plans.

faqs.q: Do you maintain vacation rental properties?
faqs.a: Yes. We schedule fixes and inspections between guest stays so the property is ready without affecting bookings.
